scope: TypeScript ReportSnapshot model parity with canonical PostgreSQL schema
finding: The TypeScript SDK exposed entity_type, entity_id, and generated_by although they are not columns on report_snapshot and are absent from the matching Python model.
change: Removed the three unsupported TypeScript fields and added a regression that requires Python and TypeScript ReportSnapshot fields to match the canonical report_snapshot columns exactly.

full_sdk_schema_parity.result: passed: 109 models, 2150 canonical columns, 1987 scalar types, 12 PostGIS types, 147 JSONB shapes, 23 enum fields, and 95 CHECK-literal fields per SDK

rollback: Restore the three TypeScript properties and remove the focused schema-parity regression; no migration or persisted data changed.
limitations: This verifies the SDK model against repository SQL definitions; it does not establish live Directus metadata or authorization parity.
